description_full: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells chemical products and process equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers g/i-Line, KrF excimer laser, ArF excimer laser, and EUV photoresists; wet etching and deep dry etching resist; developer and rinse, and stripping solution; thinner; adhesion enhancing, DSA, reflective multilayer, and file formation materials. It provides semiconductor packaging manufacturing products, including lift-off, bump formation, redistribution layer resist, protective coating materials, and adhesives; CMOS sensors and driving support system; and transparent materials and photosensitive permanent films. In addition, the company offers Sievewill, a life science research tool that traps cells and allows solutions to pass through; photo patternable permanent materials for structure fabrication/photo patternable adhesives materials; optical materials, such as NIL and hydrophilic coating materials; and high functional materials comprising porous polyimide film, and hydrophilic coating materials. The company was incorporated in 1940 and is headquartered in Kawasaki, Japan.

financial_summary: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo Co., Ltd. is a mid-cap technology business with a $5.0B market cap on $1.5B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +6% over the past three years, a respectable pace for a business of this size.
Returns on capital run at 18% against a 10% cost of capital, a 8-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it, with gross margins sitting at 36%.

The business throws off $62M in free cash flow — roughly 4 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.06× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.
Shareholder yield is only 1.1%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 7.3% of the shares.
